The fault is in [HostBlocker._is_blocked](/app/qutebrowser/components/hostblock.py:114): it checks only the exact request host against the runtime and config block sets. It also evaluates the whitelist at the end of that expression instead of returning early.

The fix should add the requested `widened_hostnames` interface in [urlutils.py](/app/qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py), then check each host and successive parent against both sets, stopping at the first match. Keep the existing blocking toggle checks, return early for whitelisted URLs, and strip a request host’s trailing dot for domain matching. An existing private generator in [configutils.py](/app/qutebrowser/config/configutils.py:42) demonstrates the specified string edge cases.

**Coverage gap:** the current tests do not check parent domain blocking. Targeted existing tests passed (9/9). Qt parses a full `https://...` URL into a host, while `QUrl("blocked.example.com")` has an empty host, so regression tests should use full URLs. Updated host blocking so a blocked domain covers its subdomains, including hosts with trailing dots. Whitelisted request URLs return early, and the per-URL blocking toggle still applies. Added `urlutils.widened_hostnames` and regression tests.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [hostblock.py](/app/qutebrowser/components/hostblock.py:131) strips trailing dots from request hosts, but the hosts parser retains them in blocked entries. A blocklist entry of `example.com.` therefore matches neither `https://example.com/` nor `https://example.com./`. I confirmed this with a local reproduction. Normalize blocked entries when loading them, or compare normalized forms on both sides.

**Tests:** `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen pytest -q tests/unit/components/test_hostblock.py tests/unit/utils/test_urlutils.py` — 356 passed, 1 skipped. No test environment problem. No project code was changed during this review.

Fixed the trailing-dot mismatch by normalizing hostnames as blocklist entries are loaded. Added regression tests for saved and config blocklists, including parent domains and dotted request hosts.
